summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The American Century Focused Large Cap Value ETF (FLV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed, non-transparent ETF that invests in a narrow selection of US large-cap value companies. The fund utilizes the Precidian non-transparent model. FLV was launched on Mar 31, 2020 and is issued by American Century Investments.

holdings.infoBox: FLV is an equity ETF with a total of 50 individual holdings. The top holdings are Marsh & McLennan Companies stock at 4.13%, Duke Energy at 3.62%, Microsoft at 3.54%, Berkshire Hathaway at 3.54%, and Johnson & Johnson at 3.36%.
